title: Panel Único de Storyboard: Escena de Contemplación en Ángulo Alto con Vista de Fiordo Nórdico
prompt: A single storyboard panel frame in a functional, minimalist sketch style for animation pre-production. The scene depicts a high-angle shot looking down at a simple grey figure sitting alone on a traditional Japanese zaisu floor chair in an empty room with large windows overlooking a misty Norwegian fjord landscape. The figure has thick black outlines and no detailed facial features, rendered in a placeholder character style. The composition emphasizes solitude and contemplation. The art style is monochrome with rough digital sketch texture, greyscale fill with subtle paper grain, and clean concept planning art aesthetic suitable for film or anime storyboarding.
